chunks: Yunus narrated from Abī al-Ḥasan al-Māḍī عليه السلام, who said:
“The perpetrators of all major sins, when the hadd is carried out upon them twice, are killed on the third time.”
Because this report is to be understood as applying to those other than the fornicator, from among those who drink intoxicants and others, as we shall explain later.
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling for someone who repeatedly commits a major sin after the hadd has already been carried out?
ai.summary: This report states a legal ruling concerning repeated commission of major sins for which prescribed punishments are carried out. It also clarifies that the report is understood as applying to offenders other than the fornicator, such as drinkers of intoxicants and others, with further explanation to come later.
